allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A, requiring the full table before any operational acceptance: every stage’s offset, type, dice, save/success, recipients and optional rider. A concrete discussion candidate is three stages at0/6/12s using8d10lightning/8d10cold/8d10thunder respectively, expiry18s; all those numbers/types are NEW and not balance-approved. Do not import a foreign ten-round storm table, quietly make one blast, or omit the native variety. GPT must select or replace the proposal with equally complete positive behavior.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Massive has no defined dimensions; Core supplies120-foot casting range, not an area size. A storm may have distinct visible volume and damage origins.
allQuestions.options: A: NEW fixed100-foot-radius,60-foot-high cylinder at a supported point within120feet. B: another explicit large3D geometry retaining the massive-storm benefit.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: A is a concrete proposal, not authority. Set vertical origin, full body intersections, roof/cover/sky and indoor behavior. Specify each stage’s ray or volume origins without revealing hidden occupants. Allcreatures versus perceived selected recipients must be explicit. No camera clipping, target-count convenience cap or silent area reduction. A fixed storm need not follow a caster; any movement must have its own exact route/speed/cost/occupied-volume rules.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: No concentration/control, repeated-cast conflict or event budget is given for the multiround storm.
allQuestions.options: A: NEW concentration for the entire finite staged lifetime; source-relative elapsed stages with per-stage recipient history. B: finite nonconcentration stages with explicit overlapping-source arbitration.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A for discussion, clearly adding concentration rather than falsely reading it from Core. Bind stages to real world time and source ID, no new caster turn, no repeated RP/cadence payments. Decide same-family overlap without erasing genuinely different scheduled types. State a stage committed before source ending versus later stages, suppression skips, source/recipient immunity, death/form changes and exact original expiry. No indefinitely autonomous weather engine.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Storm language does not specify wind, obscurement, difficult terrain, rain volume, lightning conduction, structural damage or lasting weather.
allQuestions.options: A: a visible/audible bounded storm whose selected damage table is its mechanical effect. B: add separately enumerated finite environment components with actual geometry and material consequences.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose the intended useful manifestation explicitly. A must retain varied multiround storm damage; B must supply real wind force/movement, visibility, liquid/material quantities or destruction only where chosen. Pending Control Weather, Earthquake and Absolute Silence do not supply permissions. Lightning is not thunder: a silence source may affect a genuinely thunder component only under its own selected scope, not every storm attack. No inferred faction deity or cosmological vengeance authority.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Storm CLOUD strikes5TIMES PER ROUND for6d6LIGHTNING; Core120feet/Instantaneous conflicts with a continuing cloud.
allQuestions.options: A: NEW fixed cloud with a finite three-round/18second lifetime and concentration. B: another exact finite duration/geometry and concentration choice retaining five strikes each eligible round.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Specify cloud dimensions, origin, placement range and strike range separately; a comparison is a20-foot-radius cloud at a legal point within120feet, striking within60feet of its center. All these dimensions/lifetime are NEW. Do not inherit Storm Sphere’s one-bolt ceiling or turn five strikes into five dice. Preserve lightning type despite the title. Do not fabricate a summoned creature, independent resources or weather-plane source.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: No target-allocation rule, attack/save procedure or repeat-target limit exists for the five strikes.
allQuestions.options: A: NEW five distinct ranged spell attacks, each6d6lightning, targets declared before the group resolves; repeated targets permitted. B: five source pulses with independent chosen saves and exact allocation. C: another complete five-strike procedure.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A for review, extending Storm Sphere’s actual center-origin attack contract expressly. Keep five separate events with actual cover, owner restrictions, critical rules, defense consumption and source-specific hit hooks. State what happens if an earlier strike kills/changes a later declared target; no post-roll retargeting or free information. If distinct-target-only is selected, disclose the lost single-target capability as a NEW restriction, not native text. Shared versus per-strike RNG must be fixed.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Five strikes per round leaves control expenditure, creation-round eligibility, numbering and banked opportunities unresolved.
allQuestions.options: A: one real Bonus Action on an eligible regular turn commands a group of five. B: each source-relative six-second pulse automatically issues a predeclared complete five-strike group. C: another explicitly budgeted control contract.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select the substantive control model before case authorship. A needs an actually available Bonus Action, genuine hostile initiative and an expressly chosen maximum across recasts/extra turns; it cannot charge five Bonus Actions or silently allow only one strike. B needs exact targeting and no autonomous hidden-foe knowledge. Define original pulse epochs versus numbered-round boundaries to prevent duplicate groups or a fourth group in a three-round source. Unused opportunities expire without banking or extra owner Actions.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: A committed five-strike group can encounter target death, newly lost concentration, suppression, owner incapacity or movement between strikes.
allQuestions.options: A: finish the entire already-committed snapshot group, then end future groups. B: preserve five ordered separately interruptible strike commitments with explicit legality rechecks and spent opportunities.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Confer on this real ordering choice rather than copying a one-bolt example. Preserve all committed costs, original damage-root provenance and exact sequential recipient state. Damage absorption, Wounds and concentration remain per actual event. Say precisely which later strikes fail after owner/source ending and whether missed/invalid strikes still occupy slots. Suppression/expiry cannot refill spent group history, relocate cloud or restart the duration.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Trap ONE CREATURE in an electrical field. No target size, initial save, field shape or body-following rule is printed.
allQuestions.options: A: NEW one perceived creature within120feet, initial DEX or STR admission save, fixed whole-body containment region. B: an attached source-owned confinement state with exact world boundary semantics.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose the save and success behavior explicitly; do not add arbitrary Huge immunity. Define the whole actual occupied body at establishment, field clearance, passengers/carried objects, form/size changes and legal growth. An electrical field is not automatically a solid cage object with HP or a creature. Existing Wall of Force occupancy rules are comparison only; no bisection, crushing, free displacement or implicit prison-plane admission.

Decide whether hard-control admission applies to any authored full-Action denial; confinement alone must not be mislabeled full Action denial if meaningful attacks/actions remain available. Never suppress all positive confinement as an unspecified-adapter rejection.

B: a precisely enumerated different containment rule that expressly reconciles any allowed escape with the native promise.

Specify whether the whole enclosure may move and whether outside allies can attack, heal, pull or carry the target; define targeting/line-of-effect crossing separately from body crossing. No routine repeat-save escape or generic helper-cutting fallback is printed. Actual dispel, source ending and suppression may remove containment, but their precise partial-boundary/resumption consequences require selection. Do not quietly substitute Restrained.

Actual lightning immunity/temporaryHP/Null may change damage without ending an independent boundary. Distinguish source-wide and recipient-local suppression; preserve clocks and spent histories. If a real suppressed opening allows exit, determine whether this source ends permanently or can resume only around a still-contained clear body; no retroactive recapture, cutting or teleport back. Require useful positive containment and damage cases, not only rejections.
